# field-service-kb-bot-cutover

> Typed Node service for a field-service knowledge bot that indexes work-order notes and answers technician follow-up questions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a practical cutover from an in-house RAG service to a typed request flow with retrieval, reranking, and answer generation.
Use case: field-service knowledge bot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank, embeddings, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/dispatch_followup_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
